C0879.title: Coupon Parameter Tampering for Reuse and Theft
C0879.summary: During the payment process, an attacker captured order data packets from transactions with and without a coupon, then analyzed parameter differences. On a third purchase, the attacker changed the use_coupon parameter from 0 to 4 or 6, thereby reusing or stealing a coupon that did not belong to the current account or had exceeded its usage limit, bypassing business rules to gain illicit benefits.

references.title: Shopping Platform Coupon Loophole Emerges: Should User Purchases Be Honored? - Xinhua News
